'''Shōyu''' (Japanese: '''ショウユ''' ''Shōyu'') or '''Shōyu Ninja''' (Japanese: '''忍びのショウユ''' ''Shōyu the Shinobi'') is recurring character who first appeared in ''[[HZ113|Mega Evolution - Ult]]''. He is a member of the [[Lost Mayo Maze]]. His battling partner is [[Count Hoisin]].
